lines.zh: : 还有，如果您要射在我身上，能不能先确认我是清醒的？

lines.en: : Or just...don’t ejaculate on me at all if you think that’s weird.
lines.zh: : 或者干脆……如果您觉得那样很怪，就干脆别射在我身上。

lines.en: : After all, we have no idea what {i}really{/i} happened and it could have just been some sort of...accident?
lines.zh: : 毕竟我们根本不知道{i}到底{/i}发生了什么，也许那只是某种……意外？

lines.en: : New idea. How about we just...try and put this behind us and not make any further plans about when and where it’s okay to orgasm?
lines.zh: : 新想法。我们要不要就……试着把这事翻篇，别再规划什么「什么时候、在哪里高潮是可以的」了？

lines.en: : Okay, Sir. That sounds fine to me.
lines.zh: : 好的，老师。我觉得这样挺好。

lines.en: : Also, and forgive me if I’m asking this at an inappropriate time, but do you {i}always{/i}...you know...
lines.zh: : 还有，如果我问得不是时候，请原谅，不过您是不是{i}一直{/i}都……您知道的……

lines.en: : Let out {i}that much?{/i}
lines.zh: : 射{i}那么多{/i}？

lines.en: : It just...seemed like a lot...
lines.zh: : 只是……看起来量挺大的……

lines.en: : Nevermind. Forget I asked that.
lines.zh: : 算了。当我没问。

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes39
: Oh! And also, hypothetically, if you were going to ask for something for Christmas, what would it be?
lines.zh: : 哦！还有，假设一下，如果您要圣诞礼物的话，您会想要什么？

lines.en: : Not a wardrobe.
lines.zh: : 不要衣柜。

lines.en: : I...uhh...okay?
lines.zh: : 我……呃……好吧？

lines.en: : Are you the one who got me for Secret Santa this year, Molly?
lines.zh: : 今年 Secret Santa 抽到我的人是您吗，Molly？

lines.en: : Of course not. This is entirely hypothetical. And, on a completely unrelated note, it is extremely convenient that we were able to have this conversation {i}before{/i} the gift exchange.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。这完全是假设。另外，顺便说一句，跟这个完全无关的一点：我们能在礼物交换{i}之前{/i}把这番话说清楚，真是太方便了。

lines.en: : It would have been extremely awkward for me to give you a present without clearing up the great ejaculation mystery first. Hypothetically, of course.
lines.zh: : 如果没先解开这个「射精大谜团」，我就要直接把礼物送给您，那会非常尴尬的。当然，是假设。

lines.en: : I have several comments on those last couple sentences, but I’m going to hold them to myself and just tell you to {i}hypothetically{/i} get me a gift card or something.
lines.zh: : 我对最后那几句话有一堆意见，不过我打算憋着，只建议您{i}假设性地{/i}送我一张礼品卡什么的。

lines.en: : A gift card, Sir? Is that really what you’d want?
lines.zh: : 礼品卡吗，老师？您真的想要那个？

lines.en: : There aren’t many things I want. So either do that or just...get me whatever you think I’d like.
lines.zh: : 我想要的东西不多。所以要么送那个，要么就……您觉得我会喜欢什么，就送什么。

lines.en: : Hypothetically, you mean.
lines.zh: : 您是说，假设性地。

lines.en: : Right...
: Hypothetically.
lines.zh: : 假设性地。

lines.en: scene black
I don’t stick around much longer than that because, despite the conversation actually managing to smooth things over to some extent, I still can’t help but feel uncomfortable around Molly.
lines.zh: 我没再多待多久，因为尽管这场对话确实在某种程度上把事情抹平了，我还是忍不住在 Molly 身边感到不自在。

lines.en: I’m pretty sure she notices this, too, as she slides closer to the edge of her bench and further away from me.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定她也注意到了，因为她往长凳边缘挪了挪，离我更远了些。

lines.en: It’s no longer just inches between us.
lines.zh: 我们之间不再是区区几英寸。

lines.en: It still feels like miles, though.
lines.zh: 但感觉上，依然像隔着几英里。
